data.long_meaning: The name Freudberg comes from German roots, translating to 'rock fortress'. The name may have originated from Old High German, with the element 'fried' meaning 'peace' or 'protection', and 'berg' meaning 'mountain' or 'rock'. This name suggests a strong and protective figure, as well as a connection to the natural world.
